answer: Auction a fixed number of trading licenses each epoch; no license, no trades. A license costs a 30,000 POA copper-stamped deposit, refunded only after a clean epoch. Forging 1,000 fakes means winning 1,000 licenses at 30,000 POA each, or 30,000,000 POA locked, while one honest agent pays 30,000 once. A fake trade forfeits the deposit, burns half, pays the reporter the rest, and bars the identity for 4 epochs. Fakes pile up like a dune, but the inlet stays narrow. The limit is that wealthy attackers can still buy licenses, and high prices can squeeze honest newcomers.
